sections.title: Ring Box
sections.note: The box Vasu gives you, and its two upgrades.

items.name: Ring Box
items.howTo: Holds the rings you can wear (you wear one at a time); Vasu stores the rest.

tiers.name: L-1 Ring Box (1 ring)
tiers.howTo: Vasu gives it free the first time you talk to him at Vasu Jewelers in Horon Village.

tiers.name: L-2 Ring Box (3 rings)
tiers.howTo: A Goron in a cave on Goron Mountain gives it to you (Zelda Wiki; StrategyWiki says the Red Goron).

tiers.name: L-3 Ring Box (5 rings)
tiers.howTo: Linked only. With Seasons played first: tell the Ruul Secret (from Mayor Plen's grandmother in the linked Ages, after Wing Dungeon) to Mayor Ruul in Horon Village. With Ages played first: get it in Ages with the Symmetry Secret, then tell the return secret to Farore.

sections.title: Magic Rings
sections.note: All 64 rings in ring-list order. Tick one once Vasu has appraised it; the Ring Secret shares them between linked files.

items.name: Friendship Ring
items.howTo: Vasu gives it to you free the first time you talk to him, together with the L-1 Ring Box.
items.notes: Effect: Symbol of a meeting. No effect. TourianTourist's ring guide says Vasu also gives it in a game started with the Hero's Secret, but not in a linked game; there, bring it over with the Ring Secret.

items.name: Power Ring L-1
items.howTo: Chest in the Explorer's Crypt, in the room east of the entrance.
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ▲, damage taken ▲. TourianTourist: +1 sword damage, +¼ heart on every hit you take.

items.name: Power Ring L-2
items.howTo: Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ▲▲, damage taken ▲▲. TourianTourist: +2 sword damage, +½ heart on every hit you take.

items.name: Power Ring L-3
items.howTo: Linked game only, with Ages played first: in the linked Seasons the Hero's Cave on the Western Coast becomes a long bonus dungeon. Its last chest holds this ring. You need the Roc's Cape (the seventh dungeon's treasure) to finish it.
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ▲▲▲, damage taken ▲▲▲. TourianTourist: +3 sword damage, +1 heart on every hit you take; only beats the Red Ring with the Wooden Sword.

items.name: Armor Ring L-1
items.howTo: Not found in Seasons. Get it in Ages, in the Great Moblin's Keep on Rolling Ridge, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Damage taken ▼, sword damage ▼.

items.name: Armor Ring L-2
items.howTo: Chest in the upper right corner of the upper floor of the Goron cave inside Goron Mountain, behind crumbled rocks. You need the Roc's Cape to reach it.
items.notes: Effect: Damage taken ▼▼, sword damage ▼▼. TourianTourist: sword damage actually drops by only 1.

items.name: Armor Ring L-3
items.howTo: Not found in Seasons. It comes from the linked Ages game's Hero's Cave (Seasons played first); bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Damage taken ▼▼▼, sword damage ▼▼▼. TourianTourist: sword damage actually drops by only 1.

items.name: Red Ring
items.howTo: In North Horon, cast Summer and take the stairs below the Gnarled Root Dungeon entrance to the Golden Sage. He asks you to slay the four golden beasts, each appearing in one place and one season only: the Golden Octorok in the southwest of Spool Swamp (summer), the Golden Moblin at the entrance of Snake's Remains (autumn), the Golden Lynel north of the Tarm Ruins entrance (winter) and the Golden Darknut east of the Hero's Cave (spring). Return to him for the ring.
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ×2.

items.name: Blue Ring
items.howTo: Not found in Seasons. Get it in Ages on the Sea of No Return (needs the Power Glove), and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Damage taken = ½.

items.name: Green Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 5: only from Gasha Nuts at the two class 3–5 spots, Goron Mountain and Tarm Ruins.
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ▲, damage taken ▼. TourianTourist: sword damage ×1.5 and damage taken ×0.75.

items.name: Cursed Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Chest Game (three chests in a row), and the one-time rings in the Subrosia Market (30, 40 or 50 Ore Chunks).
items.notes: Effect: ½ sword damage, damage taken ×2. A challenge ring.

items.name: Expert's Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 4: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 2–4 and 3–5 spots (Eyeglass Lake, Mt. Cucco in autumn, Goron Mountain, Tarm Ruins).
items.notes: Effect: Punch when nothing is equipped. TourianTourist: an explosive punch doing 4 damage.

items.name: Blast Ring
items.howTo: Chest right next to the pirate ship on the Western Coast, once you've sailed there with the Piratians.
items.notes: Effect: Bomb damage ▲.

items.name: Rang Ring L-1
items.howTo: Samasa Desert: a chest sits on a ridge in the southeast corner. Go two screens west, jump into the quicksand hole and follow the passage underneath to the chest.
items.notes: Effect: Boomerang damage ▲.

items.name: GBA Time Ring
items.howTo: Not found in Seasons. It's sold at the Ages Advance Shop, open only on a Game Boy Advance or Game Boy Player; bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Life Advanced! No effect. The Advance Shop stays closed on the 3DS Virtual Console. TourianTourist explains how to get the GBA rings there through Hero's and Ring Secrets.

items.name: Maple's Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the one-time 70-Ore-Chunk ring in the Subrosia Market.
items.notes: Effect: Maple meetings ▲. Maple appears after 15 kills instead of 30. TourianTourist: you only need to wear it when the meeting would happen, not while slaying.

items.name: Steadfast Ring
items.howTo: Sword & Shield Maze: once you have the Hyper Slingshot, go back to the entrance, up one room and down the stairs, then shoot all three eye statues at once to make a chest appear.
items.notes: Effect: Get knocked back less.

items.name: Pegasus Ring
items.howTo: Not found in Seasons. Get it in Ages in the Sea of Storms, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Lengthens the Pegasus Seed effect (about twice as long).

items.name: Toss Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the one-time 70-Ore-Chunk ring in the Subrosia Market.
items.notes: Effect: Throwing distance ▲ (twice as far, Bombs included).

items.name: Heart Ring L-1
items.howTo: Linked: Temple Secret, with Seasons played first. In the linked Ages, after Wing Dungeon, the Great Fairy over the dungeon's ruins in Fairies' Woods (present) tells you the secret. Here, walk through the waterfall in the Temple of Seasons room where you got the Rod of Seasons and tell it to the Great Fairy behind it.
items.notes: Effect: Slowly recover lost Hearts while moving.

items.name: Heart Ring L-2
items.howTo: Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: Recover lost Hearts while moving (about twice as fast as L-1).

items.name: Swimmer's Ring
items.howTo: Linked: Diver Secret, with Seasons played first. In the linked Ages, after Mermaid's Cave, the Master Diver's pupil on the beach above Zora Village (present) tells you the secret. Tell it to the Master Diver in the house at the Sunken City entrance and grab the star at the end of his underwater course within 30 seconds.
items.notes: Effect: Swimming speed ▲ (twice as fast).

items.name: Charge Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 4: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 2–4 and 3–5 spots (Eyeglass Lake, Mt. Cucco in autumn, Goron Mountain, Tarm Ruins).
items.notes: Effect: Spin Attack charges quickly.

items.name: Light Ring L-1
items.howTo: Not found in Seasons. Get it in Ages in a Nuun Highlands cave, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Sword beams at -2 Hearts (Noble and Master Swords only).

items.name: Light Ring L-2
items.howTo: Not found in Seasons. Win it at the Lynna Village Shooting Gallery in Ages, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Sword beams at -3 Hearts (Noble and Master Swords only).

items.name: Bomber's Ring
items.howTo: Not found in Seasons. Win it at the Goron Dance (Platinum) in Ages, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Set two Bombs at once.

items.name: Green Luck Ring
items.howTo: A one-time prize in Subrosia: the Subrosian Dance Hall and the Treasure Grove (following the Strange Brothers) each hand out mostly Gasha Seeds and Ore Chunks, but one of them eventually gives this ring and the other the Green Holy Ring.
items.notes: Effect: ½ damage from traps. TourianTourist calls it much easier to get in Ages.

items.name: Blue Luck Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Chest Game (three chests in a row), and the one-time rings in the Subrosia Market (30, 40 or 50 Ore Chunks).
items.notes: Effect: ½ damage from beams (Beamos). Ages location disagreement: Zelda Wiki says the cave above Zora Village in the present; TourianTourist lists Zora Village (past) plus the Sea of Storms (linked).

items.name: Gold Luck Ring
items.howTo: Not found in Seasons. Get it in Ages in Ambi's Palace, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: ½ damage from falls.

items.name: Red Luck Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the one-time 70-Ore-Chunk ring in the Subrosia Market.
items.notes: Effect: ½ damage from spiked floors.

items.name: Green Holy Ring
items.howTo: A one-time prize in Subrosia: either the Subrosian Dance Hall or the Treasure Grove (Strange Brothers) gives it, and the other gives the Green Luck Ring. Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Chest Game (three chests in a row), and the one-time rings in the Subrosia Market (30, 40 or 50 Ore Chunks).
items.notes: Effect: No damage from electricity.

items.name: Blue Holy Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Chest Game (three chests in a row), and the one-time rings in the Subrosia Market (30, 40 or 50 Ore Chunks).
items.notes: Effect: No damage from Zora's fire (River Zoras only).

items.name: Red Holy Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Chest Game (three chests in a row), and the one-time rings in the Subrosia Market (30, 40 or 50 Ore Chunks).
items.notes: Effect: No damage from small rocks (Octoroks). Seasons: Zelda Dungeon and StrategyWiki also list it as a Subrosian minigame prize, and TourianTourist marks it as having a fixed Seasons source without naming it. Unverified, so only the random sources are given here.

items.name: Snowshoe Ring
items.howTo: Linked: Mamamu Secret, with Ages played first. Once Mamamu Yan gives you the ring in Ages, tell her return secret to Farore in the Hall of Secrets to get it here.
items.notes: Effect: No sliding on ice. Zelda Wiki warns of a glitch where the dog vanishes for good, so save before telling her the secret.

items.name: Roc's Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the one-time 70-Ore-Chunk ring in the Subrosia Market.
items.notes: Effect: Cracked floors don't crumble.

items.name: Quicksand Ring
items.howTo: In a North Horon cave blocked by Rock Mushrooms until autumn. One screen north of Mrs. Ruul's Villa, cast Autumn, take the stairs east of the house into the river and swim one screen east, three north and one east to the mushrooms. Don't swim east any earlier, or the season resets. Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the one-time 70-Ore-Chunk ring in the Subrosia Market.
items.notes: Effect: No sinking in quicksand. TourianTourist: also stops conveyor floors from moving you.

items.name: Red Joy Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: Beasts drop double Rupees. TourianTourist: every Rupee picked up from the ground counts double.

items.name: Blue Joy Ring
items.howTo: Linked game only, with Ages played first: after Snake's Remains, Impa sends you north. Save Princess Zelda from the Great Moblin in North Horon and she gives you the ring.
items.notes: Effect: Beasts drop double Hearts.

items.name: Gold Joy Ring
items.howTo: Not found in Seasons. Get it in Ages on Rolling Ridge, and bring it over with the Ring Secret (Red Snake at Vasu's), which only works between linked files.
items.notes: Effect: Find double items (Rupees, Hearts, Ore, Bombs and seeds from the ground).

items.name: Green Joy Ring
items.howTo: Mt. Cucco: in the cave just below the Spring Banana tree (the peak you reach with the Flying Rooster). Ride the circling platform to the switch on the left, and the ring appears on the right.
items.notes: Effect: Find double Ore Chunks.

items.name: Discovery Ring
items.howTo: Chest in the Gnarled Root Dungeon, at the west end of the two Floormaster rooms on the way to the boss.
items.notes: Effect: Sense soft earth nearby: a chime plays on screens with a Gasha spot.

items.name: Rang Ring L-2
items.howTo: Random ring, class 5: only from Gasha Nuts at the two class 3–5 spots, Goron Mountain and Tarm Ruins.
items.notes: Effect: Boomerang damage ▲▲.

items.name: Octo Ring
items.howTo: Chest in a cave in the water south of Mrs. Ruul's Villa, Holodrum Plain. Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Chest Game (three chests in a row), and the one-time rings in the Subrosia Market (30, 40 or 50 Ore Chunks).
items.notes: Effect: Become an Octorok. You can't use items, but Like Likes can't eat your shield.

items.name: Moblin Ring
items.howTo: Chest in a cave east of Snake's Remains in the Woods of Winter, blocked by Rock Mushrooms: cast Autumn on the hilltop stump, then use the Magnetic Gloves to reach the chest. Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Chest Game (three chests in a row), and the one-time rings in the Subrosia Market (30, 40 or 50 Ore Chunks).
items.notes: Effect: Become a Moblin. You can't use items, but Like Likes can't eat your shield. TourianTourist: late in the game the hilltop stump is only reachable through Snake's Remains.

items.name: Like Like Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 1: Gasha Nuts from any spot whose range starts at class 1, the Chest Game (three chests in a row), and the one-time rings in the Subrosia Market (30, 40 or 50 Ore Chunks).
items.notes: Effect: Become a Like Like. You can't use items, but Like Likes can't eat your shield.

items.name: Subrosian Ring
items.howTo: Chest behind Talon in his cave on Mt. Cucco, on the way to the Dancing Dragon Dungeon. Wake him with the Megaphone from the trading sequence.
items.notes: Effect: Become a Subrosian. You can't use items, but Like Likes can't eat your shield.

items.name: First Gen Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 4: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 2–4 and 3–5 spots (Eyeglass Lake, Mt. Cucco in autumn, Goron Mountain, Tarm Ruins).
items.notes: Effect: Become something: Link as he looked in the first Zelda.

items.name: Spin Ring
items.howTo: Linked: Plen Secret, with Ages played first. Once Mayor Plen gives you the ring in Ages, tell his return secret to Farore in the Hall of Secrets to get it here.
items.notes: Effect: Double Spin Attack.

items.name: Bombproof Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 4: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 2–4 and 3–5 spots (Eyeglass Lake, Mt. Cucco in autumn, Goron Mountain, Tarm Ruins).
items.notes: Effect: No damage from your own Bombs.

items.name: Energy Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 4: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 2–4 and 3–5 spots (Eyeglass Lake, Mt. Cucco in autumn, Goron Mountain, Tarm Ruins).
items.notes: Effect: A sword beam replaces the Spin Attack.

items.name: Dbl. Edged Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 4: only from Gasha Nuts at the class 2–4 and 3–5 spots (Eyeglass Lake, Mt. Cucco in autumn, Goron Mountain, Tarm Ruins).
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ▲, but you get hurt on every hit you land. TourianTourist: +8 damage, 1 heart to you.

items.name: GBA Nature Ring
items.howTo: Buy it for 100 Rupees at the Advance Shop next to the Know-It-All Birds' hut in Horon Village. The shop only opens when Seasons runs on a Game Boy Advance or Game Boy Player.
items.notes: Effect: Life Advanced! No effect. The Advance Shop stays closed on the 3DS Virtual Console. TourianTourist explains how to get the GBA rings there through Hero's and Ring Secrets.

items.name: Slayer's Ring
items.howTo: Defeat 1,000 enemies in this save file, then talk to Vasu and he hands it over.
items.notes: Effect: 1000 beasts slain. No effect. The count is per save file and isn't carried between games.

items.name: Rupee Ring
items.howTo: Collect 10,000 Rupees in this save file, then talk to Vasu and he hands it over.
items.notes: Effect: 10,000 Rupees collected. No effect. TourianTourist: every Rupee counts, even with a full wallet; digging with a Joy Ring is a quick way. StrategyWiki calls it the Wealth Ring; Zelda Wiki, Zelda Dungeon and TourianTourist all say Rupee Ring.

items.name: Victory Ring
items.howTo: Start a new game with the Hero's Secret (from beating Ganon at the end of a linked game). The ring waits in your inventory to be appraised.
items.notes: Effect: The Evil King Ganon defeated. No effect. StrategyWiki says you get it for beating the final boss of a linked game; Zelda Wiki, Zelda Dungeon and TourianTourist all say it comes with a Hero's Secret game.

items.name: Sign Ring
items.howTo: Break 100 signs, then talk to the Sign-Loving Subrosian in the east of Subrosia, who has been counting. TourianTourist suggests a sign by the west edge of a Subrosia screen that you can break again by stepping off and back.
items.notes: Effect: 100 signs broken. No effect.

items.name: 100th Ring
items.howTo: Have Vasu appraise 100 rings in this save file (duplicates count), then he hands it over.
items.notes: Effect: 100 rings appraised. No effect. The count is per save file.

items.name: Whisp Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the one-time 70-Ore-Chunk ring in the Subrosia Market.
items.notes: Effect: No effect from jinxes (Bubbles).

items.name: Gasha Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: Grow great Gasha Trees: each kill counts double for Gasha growth, so a nut takes 20 kills instead of 40. TourianTourist: unlike Maple's Ring you must wear it while slaying for it to count.

items.name: Peace Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: No explosion if holding a Bomb.

items.name: Zora Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the one-time 70-Ore-Chunk ring in the Subrosia Market.
items.notes: Effect: Dive without breathing.

items.name: Fist Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 2: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–2, 1–3 and 2–4 spots, Maple, the Chest Game (four chests in a row), or the one-time 70-Ore-Chunk ring in the Subrosia Market.
items.notes: Effect: Punch when nothing is equipped (the weakest attack).

items.name: Whimsical Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: Sword damage ▼, sometimes deadly (a very rare one-hit kill).

items.name: Protection Ring
items.howTo: Random ring, class 3: Gasha Nuts from the class 1–3, 2–4 and 3–5 spots, Maple, or the Chest Game (five chests in a row).
items.notes: Effect: Damage taken is always one Heart.
